integrity: Exact reproducible elementary collapse and independent finite direct checking; proofs remain same-model reviewed only.
scientific_limitations: Only an explicit collapse of the Alexander dual and the integral reduced homology of the original three-cut complex are proved for n>=4p+1. No shellability or homotopy classification of the original for the new range is asserted; earlier p=2,3,4 cases and the upper large-n range are credited. Novelty may be affected by unindexed equivalent literature.
title: A sharp Alexander-dual collapse for ordinary three-cut complexes of cycle powers
